policies.sentence: Students must submit work that is their own original work.
Students must complete and submit assignments individually, not jointly with others.
Students must not have another person or entity do the writing or work for them.
Students must not substitute AI output for their own thinking or original work, or pass it off as their own.
Students must write their own code and must not copy, share, or submit code they did not write.
Students may use code presented in class despite the rule against using code they did not write.
Students are responsible and accountable for the authorship of their own work.
Authorship is the standard so that grades represent each student's own knowledge and skills; the goal is original code.
AI output is drawn from previously published work and is not original work.
